unit: crimes by foreign citizens & stateless persons
what_this_number_is: All investigated offences in 2024 whose suspect was a foreign citizen or stateless person.
source: Russian MVD — Состояние преступности в России (2024)
note: 3.6% of all registered crimes in 2024, down 0.9% vs 2023 (share: 3.3% in 2019-20, 3.9% in 2022-23). About 83% of foreign offenders are CIS citizens; ~21,953 foreigners were convicted by Russian courts in 2024.
